name: task-worker
description: Provider-neutral work graphs for multi-unit dependency, parallel, integration-gated, or resumable execution; not a default wrapper for standalone bounded work.

interface.longDescription: Use when work benefits from explicit dependencies, meaningful ready-set parallelism, separate integration gates, cross-session resume, or external handoff. It defines immutable work graphs, isolates runs in stable worktrees, and records digest-pinned verification evidence. Standalone bounded work should normally run directly, while external reviewers remain optional and independent.
defaultPrompt: Use $define only when a multi-unit graph or durable execution lifecycle has material value; do not wrap standalone bounded work.
Use $orchestrate to dispatch every ready leaf in parallel-safe worktrees while preserving integration gates.
Resume by definition or provider alias and reuse only digest-valid verification evidence.
